entities.summary: Daniel Oberkofler is an Austrian professional ice hockey player who is currently playing for the Graz99ers of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). Oberkofler competed in the 2013 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Austria men's national ice hockey team.
